methodologyNotes: Covers hard-shell rooftop cargo boxes that mount to a vehicle's roof crossbars and are sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes soft roof bags, hitch-mounted cargo carriers, roof baskets/trays, and truck-bed boxes. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. capacityCubicFt is manufacturer-listed cargo volume in cubic feet (1 cu ft = 28.3 L). lengthIn, widthIn, and heightIn are external box dimensions in inches. weightLbs is empty box weight in pounds. maxLoadLbs is the maximum rated cargo load in pounds (roof-rack limits may be lower); null if not disclosed. openingSide is an enum: driver-side, passenger-side, dual-side, or rear. mountingSystem is the crossbar attachment mechanism (e.g. quick-clamp, t-slot, u-bolt); null if not disclosed. shellMaterial is the primary shell plastic (e.g. ABS, PC-ABS, PP, fiberglass). lockingType is an enum: central-locking, key-lock, or none. skiLengthMaxCm is the manufacturer-stated maximum ski/snowboard length in centimeters; null if not published.
